seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Pieces/targets are 3x3-block sprites; walls the 3-row dotted axis. ACTION5 cycles selection axis->pieces (sorted by position)->axis; ACTION1/2 move the selection up/down 3; ACTION3/4 move a selected piece left/right 3 (the axis ignores them).
Reflections are pieces mirrored about the axis centre row. Frame is rendered by layer: wall1<target2<reflection3<piece4<counter5 (counter occludes row 63).
Holes are transparent over lower pixels; otherwise they are filled with 0 for the selection and 4 for reflections. Unselected holes stay transparent.
Objects are re-extracted from the frame: walls/pieces/reflections as 4-connected components, targets per sprite, all named by sorted (x,y); wall_h index offset = number of 0 pixels outside walls. Passes stateless too (hidden state is used only when the input matches the last output).
Unconfirmed: move guards (grid bounds, piece/axis overlap), cycle order past the first piece, actions 6/7 (treated as no-ops).
